name: shomap
description: ShoMap hackathon demo: Report. Receive. Respond.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c green,blue "npm run dev -w @shomap/server" "npm run dev -w @shomap/web"
scripts.demo: npm run build && npm run start -w @shomap/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @shomap/shared && npm run typecheck -w @shomap/server && npm run typecheck -w @shomap/web
